title: [The Lucky Nirisaka, Wares]
description: Lotus silk panels adorn the walls; dark-to-light oceanic-inspired shades rise from the floor to meet with swirls of dusky pink, gold, and jacinthe hues arched with gradient blues growing ever darker until they meet the starsilk-draped ceiling, a silken sunset over a deep ocean.  Sea life origami adds a bit of whimsy, with more displayed in a corner case.  A tall counter separates the front of the shop from the back, where numerous variations of erithi clothing are neatly stacked along shelves and in bins.
